paragraphs.en: Science is everything. Science is how society accomplishes being a society.
paragraphs.zh: 科学就是一切。科学是社会得以成为社会的方式。

paragraphs.en: Science is how everything gets done. It's how we move forward. It's how all our products get built and made better.
paragraphs.zh: 科学是一切得以实现的方式。科学是我们前进的动力。科学是我们制造所有产品并使其不断完善的途径。

paragraphs.en: We wouldn't be anywhere if we didn't have scientists constantly asking: How does this work? Can I make that? Can I make this better? Science is everything.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有科学家不断追问：这是如何运作的？我能制造那个吗？还能怎样改进？我们将一事无成。科学就是一切。

paragraphs.en: Even in high school, I knew I wanted to be an astronaut, but I had no idea what it took to be an astronaut. There's no one path to get to where I am today.
paragraphs.zh: 早在高中，我就知道自己想成为一名宇航员，但我并不清楚成为宇航员需要付出什么。其实成为宇航员没有一条固定的道路，

paragraphs.en: Some people are scientists, some people are engineers, some people are medical doctors, some people come from the military,
paragraphs.zh: 有些宇航员还是科学家、工程师或者医生，有些甚至是军人，

paragraphs.en: because what we need as astronauts are people that can do a lot of different things.
paragraphs.zh: 因为我们需要的宇航员是能够胜任多种工作的人。

paragraphs.en: We need lots of diverse people and we need diversity within a single person.
paragraphs.zh: 我很需要各种各样的人，也需要每个人具备多样性。

paragraphs.en: I was actually born and raised in Houston and so, having the Johnson Space Center in my backyard always stoked that interest for me,
paragraphs.zh: 我在休斯顿出生长大，约翰逊航天中心就在我家后院，总是激发着我的兴趣，

paragraphs.en: because I was always aware of what we were doing and what was going on and I spent about six months in space in 2010.
paragraphs.zh: 因为我一直清楚我们在做什么，也清楚发生了什么，我在2010年在太空待了大约六个月。

paragraphs.en: My ride to and from the Space Station was on the Soyuz spacecraft and I was actually trained as the co-pilot on there.
paragraphs.zh: 我乘坐联盟号运载火箭往返空间站，实际上我在空间站接受了副驾驶的培训。

paragraphs.en: So, I spent a lot of time in Russia, training and understanding, learning how to fly that spacecraft.
paragraphs.zh: 我在俄罗斯花了很多时间进行训练和学习，了解并掌握如何驾驶那艘宇宙飞船。

paragraphs.en: We will wake up in the morning. Overnight, the control centers have uplinked a schedule to us and what they want us to do that day is what we do that day.
paragraphs.zh: 我们会在早上醒来。夜间，控制中心已经向我们上传了一份日程表，他们希望我们当天做什么，我们就做什么。

paragraphs.en: And it could be maintenance. It could be science. It could be rearranging the space station. It could be dealing with stowages.
paragraphs.zh: 可能是维修、科学研究、重新布置空间站或是处理积载问题。

paragraphs.en: It's just whatever the ground needs to accomplish. And so, you do a little bit of everything in space.
paragraphs.zh: 地面中心的一切需求都是我们的任务。在空间站要做各种各样的事情。

paragraphs.en: And I remember very distinctly, for about the first month that I was in orbit, I would wake up almost every night feeling like I needed to turn over.
paragraphs.zh: 我清楚地记得，大约在进入轨道的第一个月里，我几乎每晚醒来时都感觉需要翻身。

paragraphs.en: But that doesn't do any good in space and so, you just sort of shuffle around a bit and go back to sleep.
paragraphs.zh: 但这在太空中没什么用，你只能稍微挪动一下，然后接着睡觉。

paragraphs.en: Living in space is easy. Coming back, it's pretty hard. You have lots of aches and pains because you haven't walked around for a long time.
paragraphs.zh: 在太空里生活很容易，不过回地球之后就不那么容易了。你会浑身酸痛，因为你很长时间都没有走动过了。

paragraphs.en: I mean you float in space and so, we do a lot of exercises that keep us healthy, but you haven't sat down for a long time.
paragraphs.zh: 在太空里我们一直是漂浮的，所以需要做很多锻炼来保持健康，但是很长一段时间都没有坐下来过了。

paragraphs.en: So, it gets uncomfortable to sit down for long periods of time because your body is not used to it. We're still in such early stages of the human spaceflight era.
paragraphs.zh: 长时间坐着会变得不舒服，因为你的身体还不习惯。我们仍处于人类太空飞行时代的早期阶段。

paragraphs.en: We're starting off relatively slowly, but I think as time passes, we will just get more and more people and countries into space and I think, ultimately, we will be truly a spacefaring world.
paragraphs.zh: 我们起步相对较慢，但我认为随着时间的推移，将会有越来越多的人和国家的进入太空，我认为，最终我们将成为一个遨游太空的世界。

paragraphs.en: We will be going to other planets and establishing bases and other places to live. I think that is where we're going to end up.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将前往其他行星，建立基地和其他居住地。我认为这就是我们最终的归宿。
